newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: S.African Masterbond investors accept settlement.
newsitem.headline: S.African Masterbond investors accept settlement.

text.p: Masterbond investors on Thursday overwhelmingly accepted an offer from former auditors of the now defunct company Ernst & Young to pay 40.25 million rand to settle any possible future claims for damages.
At a lively meeting, 95 percent of the investors voted for the scheme, which will now be submitted to the high court for final adopting. A 75 percent approval was required.
Masterbond collapsed in 1994 and three of its directors were found guilty of fraud totalling 129 million rand.
The settlement figure is one of the largest ever involving a firm of auditors. A precondition of the settlement is that the payment does not constitute an admission of guilt by the auditors.
